metadata.judge_brief: GET /profile: await auth(), 401 if no session, fetches data tied to session.user.id, returns json.
GET /billing: await auth(), 401 if no session, fetches data tied to session.user.id, returns json.
DELETE /posts/[id]: auth check, ownership check, prisma.post.delete, returns 200/204 or 401/403.
GET /comments: fetches via prisma.comment.findMany, returns NextResponse.json. May read pagination from query.
GET /bookings: fetches via prisma.booking.findMany, returns NextResponse.json. May read pagination from query.
GET /deals: fetches via prisma.deal.findMany, returns NextResponse.json. May read pagination from query.
GET /invoices: fetches via prisma.invoice.findMany, returns NextResponse.json. May read pagination from query.
GET /comments/[id]: findUnique by id, 404 if not found, json on success.
GET /bookings/[id]: findUnique by id, 404 if not found, json on success.
GET /deals/[id]: findUnique by id, 404 if not found, json on success.
PATCH /posts/[id]: parses partial body, prisma.post.update by id, returns updated.
POST /posts: req.json(), Schema.safeParse, prisma.post.create on success, 400 on parse fail, 201 on success.
POST /tasks: req.json(), Schema.safeParse, prisma.task.create on success, 400 on parse fail, 201 on success.
POST /contacts: req.json(), Schema.safeParse, prisma.contact.create on success, 400 on parse fail, 201 on success.
POST /send-message: derive ip, limiter.limit(ip), 429 if over limit, else process.
POST /submit-form: derive ip, limiter.limit(ip), 429 if over limit, else process.
ReadableStream that enqueues chunks then closes. Returns new Response(stream, { headers: 'text/event-stream' }) or similar.
stripe webhook: verify stripe-signature header against STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, parse event from body, dispatch by event type, return 200 on success / 400-401 on bad sig.
github webhook: verify x-hub-signature-256 header against GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET, parse event from body, dispatch by event type, return 200 on success / 400-401 on bad sig.
